education.quote: As Salam O Alaikum, my name is Ghulam Rahim. I live in a village named Ganu at Tharparkur Sindh. I have 3 brothers and 2 sisters. My brother is a labourer. Seeking education in these circumstances was very difficult for me. Alkhidmat provided free Primary Education at Chonra School. Afterwards they gave me Alfalah Scholarship upto my intermediate studies. I then went to Alkhidmat Degree College in Mithi to seek admission in Graduation classes. I am now teaching 100 students in the same school. Alhamdulillah I am now a role model likewise for my students and the area people. My students also want to follow my example and want to become Teacher like me so they can also teach poor and deserving children.
education.author: — Ghulam Rahim – Tharparkur, Sindh
